journal_lines: §cThe sculk lit up underfoot for a moment. Froze. §oIt listened. Then it stopped listening.
Something in that dark was not stone and not water. Moved around it. Took a long time.
§cHeard a sound below hearing — felt it in the chest. Went very still. Came back.
§oThe deep dark smells different than other dark. Older. Wet and electric. Did not linger.
§cBlue light opened somewhere to the left. §lWarden§c. Did not turn to look. Did not move.
Stepped on the sculk wrong. The wrong step. Stood with all weight distributed, barely breathing, until it passed.
§aThree passages in. Two passages out. Found the third. Came home through a different route than I arrived.
§cKept each paw on bare stone. §oThe sculk flowers closed as I passed them. Interesting problem.
